_comment: The Read|Glob graphify hook was removed: it fired on every source and .md read and injected ~400 tokens instructing the agent to use graphify, which agent-os/standards/code-navigation.md documents as deprecated and measurably wrong on this repo. See .claude/lessons.md 2026-09-14.
_plugins_comment: Project plugins, Anthropic's official marketplace only. frontend-design: UI craft for The Ledger work. pr-review-toolkit: silent-failure-hunter (enhancement stages must never throw OR silently swallow), pr-test-analyzer (are @spec-tagged tests real proof). Why each, and what was rejected: agent-os/tools/catalog.md.

hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*ack\ *|*ag\ *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"codebase-memory indexes this repo. For who-calls-X, blast radius, or where-X-lives, trace_path/search_graph is cheaper and authoritative for call edges. Grep is the right tool for literal strings and non-code text — scope it to a directory. graphify is deprecated here: never use it for call-graph or impact questions."}}' ;; esac; true
